task: Retain Discover browsing position across Home and Events
user_override: Re-entering Discover from Home or Events must retain the last browsed card instead of resetting the deck.

contract.identity: Stable user_id; never a cached profile or an index alone
contract.scope: Current authenticated app runtime, including Tab page replacement and internal relaunch
contract.commit: Only after the outgoing card finishes its exit; cancel/interruption retains the last settled card
contract.filtering: Keep a valid current ID; otherwise resolve a valid index, then reconcile to its stable ID; empty pool clears the cursor
contract.business_data: Read current discover_people and introduction_context; do not reseed, copy or freeze canonical entities
contract.persistence: UI-only Pinia field outside data; zero storage writes for browsing/navigation
contract.authentication: Successful auth-context change clears the cursor; failed logout preserves it
contract.reload_boundary: Full document reload / app restart creates a fresh UI cursor; business data still restores normally
contract.visual_changes: None: preserve existing card, copy, gestures, Tabbar, safe-area and transition layout
